title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — November 22, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.9)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.2 (Peaked November 22, 2026 at 20:46 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 334 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)

When Bz turns southward, solar-wind energy can enter Earth's magnetic environment more efficiently, helping increase geomagnetic activity. 🌎💫

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
